title: Existence of the ordered global twist line
statement: In the ordered free symmetric Proj comparison setting of lem-trf-symmetric-proj-ordered-twist-gluing, construct a line isomorphism t from the pulled standard O(1) to D.line by gluing the normalized affine chart isomorphisms and their inverses. Retain their normalization: for each affine base open V and each ordered coordinate i, after applying Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor to p^{-1}(V), the quotient of the pulled basis vector equals the pulled coordinateSection followed by t, with the canonical unit pullback comparisons. The claim includes r=0 and empty base charts.

proof.text: For all pairs (V,i) consisting of an affine base open and an ordered coordinate, use the affine frame theorem on U_(V,i)=p^{-1}(V)∩f^{-1}(D_+(X_i)). These opens cover. The pulled standard sections and the adjoint quotient sections are free frames there and have the same coordinate ratios. On each subopen of an overlap, expressing the i-frame as its coordinate ratio times the j-frame and cancelling the free j-frame transports every linear relation from the standard line to D.line. Scheme.Modules.isoOfIsFreeGenerator glues the uniquely determined frame maps to an isomorphism of ordinary pullbacks. Compose with boundaryPullbackComparison to obtain the required tensor-pullback isomorphism. Each pulled standard section s_i is sent to the quotient section q_i: on U_(V,j) both are the same coordinate ratio times the j-frames, so by uniqueness of glued values the global isomorphism maps s_i to q_i. Morphisms out of the structure sheaf are determined by their value at 1, and the section-normalized tensor adjunction agrees with the one defining boundaryPullbackComparison by its uniqueness; hence the quotient of each pulled basis vector equals the pulled coordinateSection followed by t, globally and hence after restriction to each inverse-image affine base open.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_ordered_twist_line (S : Scheme.{u}) (E : S.Modules)
    [E.IsQuasicoherent] (D : ProjectiveBundleQuotientGeometry.TautologicalQuotient E)
    (r : ℕ) (b : RelativeProjectiveSpace.freeModule S r ≅ E)
    (eRel : (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProj ≅
      RelativeProjectiveSpace.scheme S r)
    (hRel : eRel.hom ≫ RelativeProjectiveSpace.π S r =
      (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjHom)
    (hAffine : ∀ V : S.affineOpens,
      ProjectiveBundleQuotientGeometry.AffineFreeComparison r b eRel V)
    (θ : RelativeProjectiveSpace.scheme S r ≅ ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin (r + 1)); S))
    (hθ : θ.hom ≫ (ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin (r + 1)); S) ↘ S) =
      RelativeProjectiveSpace.π S r)
    (hθAffine : ∀ V : S.affineOpens, RelativeProjectiveSpace.IsIntegralProjComparison
      S r V (RelativeProjectiveSpace.affineToIntegral S r θ V)) :
    ∃ t : (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (eRel ≪≫ θ).hom).obj
        (ProjectiveSpace.twist (ULift.{u} (Fin (r + 1))) S 1) ≅ D.line,
    ∀ V : S.affineOpens, ∀ i : ULift.{u} (Fin (r + 1)),
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
          ((SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjHom ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback
          (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjHom).map
        (SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := S.ringCatSheaf) i ≫ b.hom) ≫ D.quotient) =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
          ((SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjHom ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι).map
        (((Scheme.Modules.boundaryPullbackComparison
          (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjHom).app
            (Scheme.Modules.unit S) ≪≫
        Scheme.Modules.pullbackObjUnitIso
          (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjHom).hom ≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.boundaryPullbackComparison (eRel ≪≫ θ).hom).app
          (Scheme.Modules.unit _) ≪≫
        Scheme.Modules.pullbackObjUnitIso (eRel ≪≫ θ).hom).inv ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (eRel ≪≫ θ).hom).map
        (ProjectiveSpace.coordinateSection (ULift.{u} (Fin (r + 1))) S i) ≫ t.hom)

statement_change.old_statement: Construct the global line isomorphism by gluing normalized local chart isomorphisms and their inverses.
statement_change.what: The old existential returned True and forgot the affine coordinate normalization specified in its docstring and used by its parent. Bare line existence does not imply preservation by every line isomorphism. Retain the normalized coordinate equations after restriction above each affine base open. This strengthens this still-unproved gluing obligation; it is an interface correction, not a proof or a new split. On merging with the landed F1 proof (a1ed29fbb3f), the glued isomorphism of that proof is shown to satisfy the retained equations, so the strengthened statement is proved.
